description.zh: 经典中国象棋双人对弈。红黑双方轮流走棋，支持完整象棋规则——将军、将死、困毙、蹩马腿、塞象眼、炮打隔子、将帅对脸，附带悔棋、棋谱与胜负统计。
description.en: Classic Xiangqi for two players taking turns. Full rule support - check, checkmate, stalemate, horse-leg blocking, elephant-eye blocking, cannon screen captures and the facing-generals rule. Includes undo, move record and win stats.

controls.zh: 鼠标点击选子，再点击目标位置落子
controls.en: Click a piece, then click the destination
